mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for HOUST*INDPRO interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annualized), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annualized, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth, as measured by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), indicates robust consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day return when PAYEMS increases is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 2.0% signals weak economic expansion, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth is below 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO decline exceeding 2.0% month-over-month), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profits and increases uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines more than 2.0% MoM, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an overheating economy with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed is likely to continue tightening.
regime_hint: overheating economy with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS*UNRATE interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
